{{Quote|He named himself Kaddak. They say he took the first name of the Mandalorian destroyer god, Kad Ha'rangir, and used it forwards and backwards.|[[Hock Malsuum]]|<ref name="DVaCoS2" />}}
'''Kaddak''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]. 

==History==
Born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], Kaddak was bred to serve in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], and received [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] training by a Mandalorian<ref name="DVaCoS2" /> member of the ''[[Cuy'val Dar]]''.<ref name="GttGaR">{{InsiderCite|84|Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic}}</ref> Learning of Mandalorian history and culture, the clone [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] took the name Kaddak for himself from the destroyer [[God/Legends|god]] of [[Mandalorian religion|Mandalorian mythology]], [[Kad Ha'rangir]], creating a palindrome of the ancient deity's first name.<ref name="DVaCoS2" />

Over [[Time/Legends|time]], Kaddak came to feel that the clones of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] Grand [[Army/Legends|Army]] were [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]], and his relationship with his ''Cuy'val Dar'' trainer grew contentious, until finally the two fought and Kaddak [[Death/Legends|killed]] the Mandalorian instructor with his bare [[Limb/Legends|hands]]. As a result, Kaddak was imprisoned on Kamino and deemed a failure by his [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] superiors, who sought to study him and determine why he had deviated from their behavioral standards. While incarcerated, Kaddak exercised furiously, and had his self-given name [[Tattoo/Legends|tattooed]] repeatedly across his body. In an effort to differentiate himself from the other clones who looked like him, Kaddak deliberately scarred his face, and kept his head shaved bare. When the Kaminoan tests were completed, rumors told that Kaddak had been put to death, while others insisted that he had escaped his captors and fled.<ref name="DVaCoS2" /> This was proven true when Kaddak resurfaced on [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ostor]] allied with the local [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdouts]]. He later explained to fellow clone trooper [[Hock Malsuum]] that he wanted to create a more equal society on that planet. Kaddak tried to convince Hock to join him, but Hock used this opportunity to help [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] penetrate the Ostor's capital city. For this betrayal, Kaddak attacked Hock, but was killed in the fighting.

==Behind the scenes==
Kaddak first appeared in the [[Darth Vader and the Cry of Shadows 2|second issue]] of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series ''[[Star Wars: Darth Vader and the Cry of Shadows]]'', [[Author/Legends|authored]] by [[Tim Siedell]] and published [[January 14]], [[2013]].
